races.paceDynamic: Brains is the sole confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead with Pinball Wizard, Royal County Glory and Rock Etoile sitting just behind in the prominent positions. The large field of 16 runners includes 12 hold-up horses who will be relying on the pace collapsing in the final two furlongs. With only one true leader, Brains can dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure, which typically favours horses that can travel prominently and kick when the pace lifts. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front runners who can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Brains sets a steady tempo and maintains his kick in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader and prominent runners to save energy for a decisive move, while the large pack of hold-up horses gets caught in traffic or arrives too late. Horses positioned within the first six at halfway have a significant tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup as prominent runners tie up after dictating, allowing late closers with tactical speed to sweep past in the final 100 yards. Fresh legs and a strong finishing kick become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Brains gets soft fractions and finds another gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The veteran exploits his uncontested position to build an unassailable lead, with his stamina reserves proving superior to horses trying to close from midfield or further back. His course form and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Brains stops suddenly and the prominent horses all empty out together
scenarios.body: The race turns into a sprint from the two-furlong pole with hold-up horses flying home, but the congestion and lack of early pace creates a messy finish where positioning luck becomes crucial. The best stayers emerge from the chaos.

races.paceDynamic: Just Keep Flying and Spanish Rising are confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead in this 19-runner handicap over 1m4f. With two willing pace-setters, expect an honest gallop from the start that will string out this large field. The sustained tempo over the extended trip will create a true test of stamina. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish powerfully, as the early pace battle will leave the leaders vulnerable in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both Just Keep Flying and Spanish Rising go forward aggressively from the start
scenarios.body: The dual pace angle creates an honest tempo that suits closers perfectly over this stamina-sapping trip. Hold-up horses like Stellar Quality, Flying Fortress and Obscenity can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Contested But Sustainable
scenarios.trigger: If one front runner drops back early leaving a single leader
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more manageable allowing prominent runners to stay closer and kick earlier. Not Just Any Eagle and Beauparc can track the tempo and have enough left to sustain their challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Early Fractions
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are restrained creating crawling early splits
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish favouring horses with tactical speed over pure stamina. Prominent runners can position perfectly for a devastating late kick when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Just Keep Flying gets loose on the lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: An uncontested leader can dictate terms and potentially stay on for glory over this trip. The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to reserve energy for a strong finish.

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby will lead unopposed from the start, setting a comfortable tempo with no sustained early pressure from the prominent runners Tachos, Ob La Di and Chica Guerrera who will likely settle behind her. The pace should be sustainable rather than punishing given the lack of multiple confirmed pace-setters, allowing the race to develop into a stamina test over the final three furlongs. With a modest gallop likely and the 1m1½f distance providing time for position changes, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby sets a steady pace and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows the closers to get into perfect striking position and overwhelm the leaders with superior finishing kicks. Hold-up specialists like Pink Oxalis and Akecheta can utilise their proven ability to quicken from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front running tactics pay
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby quickens the tempo mid-race and puts pressure on the field
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from mounting their usual late challenges. Thrifty Of Digby's course form and tactical advantage proves decisive with the prominent runners following her home.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses position perfectly and kick together entering the straight
scenarios.body: Tachos and Ob La Di time their moves to perfection, getting first run on the leaders while having enough pace to hold off the closers. Their tactical positioning proves the winning formula in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits all
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The crawling pace turns the contest into a pure speed test where any horse can win regardless of running style. The finish becomes a lottery with form lines thrown out the window in the dash to the line.

races.paceDynamic: Hardy Warrior, Bunyola Bay and Honouramongthieves will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three natural front-runners likely to press forward early over this stamina-testing 1m1½f trip. The sustained pace will stretch the field and create a searching test, particularly on good ground at Gowran Park where the emphasis falls on staying power. This strong gallop will suit prominent racers and hold-up horses with a turn of foot, while leaders may pay for their early exertions. The race shape clearly favours horses that can settle behind the pace and deliver their challenge in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Warrior and Bunyola Bay duel from the front
scenarios.body: The leaders will set unsustainable fractions over this trip, allowing closers to pick up the pieces. Hold-up horses with class like Killashee Warrior and Summer Is Tomorrow will thrive off the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Perisher can settle just behind the leaders
scenarios.body: The in-form Perisher can avoid the early burn-up while staying close enough to strike. His recent winning form and prominent style perfectly suits tracking the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Warrior gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: With Bunyola Bay and Honouramongthieves potentially cancelling each other out, Hardy Warrior could steal a march. His class and OR 107 rating would be decisive if allowed easy fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners compromise each other
scenarios.body: A messy early pace battle could set up a sprint finish that doesn't suit this trip. The race would become tactical and favour the most talented regardless of position.

races.paceDynamic: Private Larry and Jewels Legacy are the confirmed front-runners, but both carry warnings for fading in the finish and lack recent form sharpness. This sets up a moderate early pace that should suit prominent racers like Accelereight and Onyeisi to track the leaders before the pace-setters weaken. The combination of willing but vulnerable leaders and a competitive handicap field over 1m1½f creates a race where horses with tactical speed can position handy and kick when the early leaders tire. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those that can settle close enough to strike when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Accelereight and Onyeisi track the pace-setters perfectly through the early stages
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop set by fading leaders allows sharp prominent racers to hit top gear just as Private Larry and Jewels Legacy weaken in the final two furlongs. Accelereight's recent Ballinrobe second and Onyeisi's consistent placing record make them ideally suited to exploit this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses dramatically in the final three furlongs allowing strong finishers to close
scenarios.body: Pliny's class advantage becomes decisive as he sweeps past tired leaders, with his proven ability to finish strongly over this trip. Sweet Baby Zou and other hold-up merchants benefit from the strong pace setup despite their recent struggles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Surprise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Private Larry defies his fading tendency and maintains his front-running kick to the line
scenarios.body: The early leader finds improvement from gelding and first-time headgear, sustaining his gallop better than expected. Jewels Legacy or another pace-setter capitalizes on a tactical race where nobody makes a decisive move.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper has been lenient and a lightly-raced improver finds significant progress
scenarios.body: Connova returns much sharper after 211 days off, or Swinging The World benefits dramatically from stable change and gelding. The competitive nature of the handicap allows a horse on the upgrade to exploit the pace scenario.

Connova and Swinging The World return from extended breaks exceeding 200 days, fitness highly questionable
Accelereight and Onyeisi are perfectly positioned as prominent runners to exploit the likely pace setup
Multiple horses trying headgear for first time including Private Larry (hood) and Music And Song (blinkers)

races.paceDynamic: Zitkala Sa, A Pretty Penny, and Borora Aura will force a strong early gallop in this competitive handicap with Canon Law also likely to race prominently. The sustained pace over 1m1½f will test stamina reserves, particularly given the good ground conditions at Gowran Park. With multiple front-runners committed to racing forward, the pace will be honest throughout creating a true test. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish late, as the early leaders will soften each other up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters go too fast early and tie up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will set up perfectly for horses with proven late kick who can pick off tired leaders. Patient tactics will be rewarded as stamina tells over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead and controls fractions
scenarios.body: A Pretty Penny or Borora Aura could steal a march if the others go too hard, allowing them to dictate and kick clear. Their natural speed advantage becomes decisive if they avoid the early battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: Without genuine pressure early, the race becomes a sprint finish where natural speed trumps stamina. The front-runners retain energy for a sustained drive to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper has underestimated an improver who benefits from the strong pace
scenarios.body: A lightly-raced sort with untapped potential could emerge from the pack as others weaken. The combination of pace setup and weight relief creates the perfect storm.
